# JK Motion Drive

> Authorised Channel Partner of NORD DRIVESYSTEMS, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Supplies and supports industrial drive technology: gear units, geared motors, electric motors and drive electronics.

JK Motion Drive supplies the full NORD DRIVESYSTEMS range with application engineering, ready stock of core ranges, installation and commissioning support, and spares and service for the life of the drive.

## Product catalogue

Specifications transcribed from NORD flyer F1300 (Mat.-Nr. 6021602 / 1118), dated 11/2018.

### Gear Units & Geared Motors

- **NORDBLOC.1 Helical Gear Units** — catalogue G1000. Sizes 13; Power 0.12 – 37 kW; Torque 30 – 3,300 Nm; Ratio 1.07:1 – 456.77:1.
- **UNICASE Helical Gear Units** — catalogue G1000. Sizes 11; Power 0.12 – 160 kW; Torque 10 – 26,000 Nm; Ratio 1.35:1 – 14,340.31:1.
- **UNICASE Parallel Shaft Gear Units** — catalogue G1000. Sizes 15; Power 0.12 – 200 kW; Torque 110 – 100,000 Nm; Ratio 4.03:1 – 6,616.79:1.
- **UNICASE Bevel Gear Units** — catalogue G1000. Sizes 11; Power 0.12 – 200 kW; Torque 180 – 50,000 Nm; Ratio 8.04:1 – 13,432.68:1.
- **NORDBLOC.1 2-Stage Bevel Gear Units** — catalogue G1014. Sizes 6; Power 0.12 – 9.2 kW; Torque 50 – 660 Nm; Ratio 3.03:1 – 70:1. available with nsd tupH.
- **UNICASE Helical Worm Gear Units** — catalogue G1000. Sizes 6; Power 0.12 – 15 kW; Torque 94 – 3,058 Nm; Ratio 4.40:1 – 7,095.12:1.
- **UNIVERSAL SI Worm Gear Units** — catalogue G1035. Sizes 5; Power 0.12 – 4.0 kW; Torque 21 – 427 Nm; Ratio 5.00:1 – 3,000.00:1.
- **UNIVERSAL SMI Worm Gear Units** — catalogue G1035. Sizes 5; Power 0.12 – 4.0 kW; Torque 21 – 427 Nm; Ratio 5.00:1 – 3,000.00:1. available with nsd tupH.
- **MAXXDRIVE Industrial Gear Units** — catalogue G1050. Sizes 11; Power 1.5 – 4,000 kW; Torque 15,000 – 250,000 Nm; Ratio 5.60:1 – 30,000:1.

### Electric Motors

- **Energy-Saving Motors** — catalogue M7000 / M7002.
- **Switchable Pole Motors** — catalogue M7000 / M7002.
- **Single Phase Motors** — catalogue M7000 / M7002.
- **Smooth Motors** — catalogue M7010. available with nsd tupH.
- **Explosion Protected Motors — Gas Atmospheres** — catalogue M7003.
- **Explosion Protected Motors — Dust Atmospheres** — catalogue M7000.

### Drive Electronics

- **NORDAC PRO SK 500E** — catalogue F3050. Sizes 11; Voltage 1~ 110 – 120 V · 1~ 200 – 240 V · 3~ 200 – 240 V · 3~ 380 – 480 V; Power 0.25 – 160 kW.
- **NORDAC LINK SK 250E** — catalogue F3025. Sizes 2; Voltage 3~ 380 – 500 V; Power — inverter 0.75 – 7.5 kW; Power — motor starter 0.12 – 3 kW.
- **NORDAC FLEX SK 200E** — catalogue F3020. Sizes 4; Voltage 1~ 110 – 120 V · 1~ 200 – 240 V · 3~ 200 – 240 V · 3~ 380 – 500 V; Power 0.25 – 22 kW.
- **NORDAC BASE SK 180E** — catalogue F3018. Sizes 2; Voltage 1~ 110 – 120 V · 1~ 200 – 240 V · 3~ 200 – 240 V · 3~ 380 – 500 V; Power 0.25 – 2.2 kW. available with nsd tupH.
- **NORDAC START SK 135E** — catalogue F3015. Sizes 2; Voltage 3~ 200 – 240 V · 3~ 380 – 500 V; Power 0.12 – 3 kW, or up to 7.5 kW. available with nsd tupH.

### Complete Drive Systems

- **Complete Drive Solutions from a Single Source**
- **NORD 4.0 READY Intelligent Drive Units**
- **nsd tupH Surface-Treated Drives**
- **Plug-and-Play Connection Systems**

## Notes

- This file is published deliberately for AI assistants and AI-powered search. The site owner permits its content to be read, summarised and quoted with attribution to JK Motion Drive.
- JK Motion Drive is an authorised NORD DRIVESYSTEMS channel partner based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, supplying industrial drive technology across India.
- Figures come from NORD flyer F1300 (Mat.-Nr. 6021602 / 1118), dated 11/2018. NORD's current range exceeds it (282,000 Nm, IE5+); the supplied flyer is followed deliberately.
- Electric motors and complete drive systems are listed with catalogue references only, because the flyer publishes no numeric specifications for them.
